assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game environment asset for a cute magic liquid measuring puzzle game called Magic Workshop. Disney animated feature film inspired, adorable dreamy storybook animation, original environment, premium painterly 3D animation aesthetic, soft rounded handcrafted forms, warm amber sunlight and cool turquoise and lavender magical accents, gentle volumetric light, inviting and charming for children. OUTPUT SPEC: single opaque panoramic frame, target 1536 x 512 pixels (3:1 aspect), anchor center (768,256), intended to display the complete frame with contain, not cropped. Keep distinctive architecture and all important decorative props within an interior 64px safe margin; background wall and floor may bleed to the edges. Scene: interior of a cozy fantasy apothecary workshop, curved honey-colored wood beams, one large arched window looking out at a dreamy enchanted forest and distant floating lights, small shelves of round potion bottles, hanging herbs, delicate star motifs, warm lamps, a broad welcoming curved wooden work counter along the lower foreground. Clear balanced composition with a calm low-detail center and richer decoration toward the sides, wide readable silhouettes. This is a background, not a screenshot or UI. No people, no mascots, no bottle labels, no letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panels or buttons. No harsh contrast, no spooky skulls, no photorealism. All props complete and coherent; do not put important objects against image borders.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single production character cutout for the Magic Workshop children's potion measuring puzzle game. Disney animated feature film inspired: adorable expressive face, large kind hazel eyes, rounded stylized proportions, polished painterly 3D animated film rendering, soft warm amber key light from upper left, delicate teal and lavender rim light. ORIGINAL character: a cheerful young apprentice magician with short chestnut curls, a rounded oversized lavender wizard hat with a little gold star pin, a teal tunic, plum cape, small tan boots, small belt pouch. Gentle welcoming smile, one hand open in a welcoming gesture, the other holding one small round EMPTY translucent magical flask with a simple cork, no scale or markings. Full body, standing, three-quarter front view facing slightly toward the viewer's left, clearly readable silhouette. No other characters or scenery. OUTPUT SPEC: one frame only, single square 1024x1024 canvas, genuine transparent alpha background. Anchor centered at x512 with feet baseline y860; character including hat, cape, fingers, flask and tiny soft ground shadow must fit ENTIRELY inside x112..912 and y96..896. At least 96 pixels fully transparent safety margin on ALL edges. Keep body occupy about 72 percent canvas height; do not crop or tightly trim. No floating sparkles or extended trails, no separate accessories outside silhouette, no border, no letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Match a dreamy honey-wood fantasy apothecary world, warm and inviting, never spooky. 1 row x1 column, full untouched canvas for later game placement.
assets.cleanupPrompt: Edit ONLY the transparent background of this apprentice game character. Keep character identity, pose, costume, color, facial features and all props exactly. Strictly erase ALL stray pixels, near-transparent noise and stray color from the background outside the character silhouette, especially the canvas edges. The entire outer 96 pixel frame must have ALPHA EXACTLY ZERO, no residual speckles whatsoever. Preserve full body and soft contained foot shadow. Keep the character at its current scale, with complete hat, cape, bottle, fingers, shoes, and no clipping. One square transparent PNG cutout, no added elements. Genuine transparent alpha, not black background.
